posts.cooked:
First, I like rhymes, hence the title.

Second. This is for fun.

I just came up with an idea for Fanatic. IIMagine this scenario.

"Normal Fanatic is in play. She has her armor equipment card in play (I forgot the name and my deck isn't near me.... damn me). She dies, activating it. Instead of coming back with 10HP on her Normal Fanatic Side, she becomes her Redeemer Fanatic?

Can this possibly work, or is it broken, impossible or simply OPed?

Sadly for whatever reason I have never tried it out, that and for some reason Aegis of Resurrection ever appears in my hand. I'm not sure how game breaking it would be, it doesn't sound like it would be too bad as probably by that point you wouldn't be using her base power much anyhow. Also if you keep her current HP the same instead of increasing it like her max HP was.

posts.name: Blossercubbles
posts.cooked: That could be interesting. I could see her resurrecting and being redeemed. I would keep the 10 HP thing, remove that Aegis from the game, and allow any other Aegis that comes into play to do something else, either increase Fanatic's damage by 1 or an instant heal of 5 or so.
